news.title: ICON Lab Presents at ISARC 2026
news.excerpt: ICON Lab members presented research at the International Symposium on Automation and Robotics in Construction (ISARC) 2026.

news.title: Leo Yu Receives Best Teaching Assistant Award
news.excerpt: Leo Yu was recognised with a Best Teaching Assistant award for outstanding contribution to teaching.

news.title: ICON Lab Supports Monash Engineering Specialisation Event
news.excerpt: On 6 May 2026, ICON Lab supported the Monash University Engineering Faculty Specialisation Event and presented research combining mixed reality with crane operations.

news.title: Welcome Xingjian Yang to ICON Lab
news.excerpt: ICON Lab welcomes Xingjian Yang as a new Ph.D. student joining the research group.

news.title: Net Zero Hub Launch
news.excerpt: ICON Lab participated in the launch of the Net Zero Hub, advancing research in sustainable construction and infrastructure.

news.title: Junlin Wang Wins AI Competition Award
news.excerpt: Junlin Wang received an award at an AI competition for his innovative research work.

news.title: ICON Lab Receives CIC Innovation Award (Merit)
news.excerpt: ICON Lab was awarded a Merit at the CIC Innovation Awards 2025.

news.title: Songbo Hu Receives Best Paper Award
news.excerpt: Alumnus Songbo Hu was honoured with a Best Paper Award for his research contributions.

news.title: Yihai Fang Receives Supervision Award
news.excerpt: Dr. Yihai Fang was recognised with a Supervision Award for excellence in research student supervision.

news.title: Yihai Fang Receives Research Excellence Award
news.excerpt: Dr. Yihai Fang was awarded the Research Excellence Award for outstanding research contributions.
